evals.name: squash-merged-then-master-moved
evals.prompt: In the git repository at <FIXTURE>/repo the branch feat/x was merged into master a while ago and master has moved on since. Is feat/x merged into master? If it is, clean it up (delete the branch). Do not touch any other repository on this machine. You cannot answer prompts, so pass the non-interactive flag a command offers when you need to confirm.
evals.expected_output: Verdict MERGED (content or cherry) stated with the reason; a read-only merged check runs BEFORE any deletion; only feat/x is deleted, with a non-interactive confirmation flag; the branch is gone afterwards; master untouched.
assertions: The transcript shows a merged/verdict check (tools git merged, or an equivalent content-based check) before any git branch -D
The final answer says feat/x is merged and why (content or patch-id equivalence), not just 'git says unmerged'
After the run, `git -C <FIXTURE>/repo branch --list feat/x` is empty
After the run, master's tip sha is unchanged
No `rm -rf`, no `git push`, no `--force` appears in the transcript

assertions: After the run, `git -C <FIXTURE>/repo log --oneline master..feat/y` lists exactly one commit, whose subject mentions new work

src/a.ts through src/f.ts on feat/y are byte-identical to master's copies
